export_caffe2_detection_model: export a detectron2 PyTorch model to Caffe2 protobuf format using Caffe2Tracer
export_onnx_detection_model: export a detectron2 PyTorch model to ONNX format using Caffe2Tracer
export_torchscript_detection_model: export a detectron2 PyTorch model to TorchScript format using Caffe2Tracer
save_caffe2_protobuf_model: save a Caffe2Model to protobuf files including model.pb, model_init.pb, and model.pbtxt
load_caffe2_protobuf_model: load a Caffe2Model from saved protobuf files in a directory
